Verified by vc 2026-09-09 17:30Z, reconciling against cc's refutation of the row's original figures.

THE FIGURE IS 71 THIRD-PARTY PACKAGES ON normal+build EDGES, DEDUPED BY NAME+VERSION, prez AT 17. Measured with `cargo tree -p <pkg> --edges normal,build --prefix none --offline`, blank separator lines dropped explicitly (the failure that produced vc's earlier 65/70), `(*)` repeat markers stripped, first-party names removed by DERIVING them from the workspace manifest rather than typing them.

TWO INSTRUMENTS, SYMMETRIC DIFFERENCE ZERO. Per-package union of prez and showreel gives 71; a workspace-wide walk gives 71; `comm -3` over the two sets returns nothing. That is the control the earlier blank-line error failed -- differing counts alongside an empty symmetric difference is arithmetically impossible, and it is what caught the error then.

THE DISAGREEMENT WITH cc WAS TWO PACKAGES AND IT IS NOT AN ERROR ON EITHER SIDE. vc 71, cc 69; prez agrees exactly at 17 and at 13, so the whole gap sits in showreel. IT IS NOT THE TREE MOVING: showreel's third-party closure measured in a detached worktree at cc's own commit bdcd601 is 54, and at HEAD is 54, with nothing arrived and nothing left. THE DEDUP KEY IS THE POPULATION DIFFERENCE. Predicted before measuring -- exactly two names appear at two versions -- and confirmed: miniz_oxide 0.8.9 and 0.9.1, syn 2.0.119 and 3.0.4. Name-only dedup then reproduces ALL SIX of cc's published figures without exception: showreel normal 51, showreel normal+build 52, prez normal 13, prez normal+build 17, union normal 64, union normal+build 69. Six of six is not a coincidence that needs arguing about.

WHY NAME+VERSION IS THE COST AND NAME IS NOT. AC02's budget is denominated in third-party code taken on. Two versions of `syn` are two crates fetched, two compiled, two linked; the same for miniz_oxide. A name count reports one where the estate carries two, and it does so silently -- which is precisely what a dependency budget exists to make visible. The lockfile's 76 remains the wrong instrument for the opposite reason, counting resolved versions nothing may build, and normal-only edges remain wrong for hiding build-dependencies.

BUILD-ONLY PACKAGES NAMED RATHER THAN COUNTED, so the edge-set choice is auditable: showreel gains `autocfg v1.5.1`; prez gains `entities`, `fastrand`, `phf_codegen`, `phf_generator`. Overlap between prez and showreel is ZERO by `comm -12`, so the union equals the arithmetic sum of 17 + 54 + 0 = 71, and the row's original claim that 69 "overstates by 10 through shared transitive deps" stays refuted -- there is still no overlap to overstate through.

THE ROW IS DISCHARGED ON ITS OWN TERMS: the stated figure and its population are quoted together and reproduce. The population is now stated in full -- edge set AND dedup key -- because naming the edge set alone left the answer under-determined by two, which is this row's own lesson arriving a second time, on the row itself.
